articleTitle: MPPT Control Strategy of Photovoltaic Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Since 21th century, the global economy has developed rapidly, coupled with the improvement of people's awareness of environmental protection, renewable energy technology has attracted more and more attentions around the world. Solar energy has the characteristics of cleanness and abundant reserves, so it is more in line with the current requirements for energy in terms of quality and quantity. According to the basic principle of maximum power point tracking technology of photovoltaic, this paper comprehensively compares and analyzes the current maximum power point tracking technology of photovoltaic cells. In order to solve the shortcomings of the traditional maximum power point tracking control strategy, an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) control strategy based on parameter coordination for maximum power point tracking of photovoltaic cells proposed in the paper. So it can solve the problem that the traditional PSO algorithm falls into local extreme value in the tracking process. Finally, by building a simulation model of three-phase photovoltaic grid-connected power generation system using Matlab/Simulink, the improved PSO algorithm is used to track the maximum power point. The simulation results show that the improved PSO algorithm can be better applied to the three-phase photovoltaic grid-connected power generation system, and the MPPT can be realized faster. Meanwhile, the output power quality is better.

articleTitle: Analysis for the Usage of Li-ion Battery in Electric Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Because of the rapid development of the aviation industry, people need to seek a way to reduce CO2 emissions. The most effective method is to use electricity to substitute fossil fuels. The Li-ion batteries are appropriate to employ in electric aircraft. The Li-ion batteries have some advantages over other options. The Li-ion battery not only has the most capacity and density of any battery in its class, and it is also the lightest in weight. Thus, for large vehicles, Li-ion batteries not only provide a reduction in the weight of the vehicle but also provide a lot of energy. Both of these features can significantly accelerate the flight speed and extend the flight distance. Li-ion batteries not only require low maintenance fee, but it also does not require regular maintenance. Lithium batteries do not have a memory effect, so they will not affect the batteries' energy capacity. However, the disadvantage of lithium-ion batteries cannot be ignored. First of all, for future mass production of electric vehicles, the current high manufacturing price of batteries is unacceptable. For batteries used in vehicles, the “thermal runaway” problem of batteries causing explosions and fires can be very dangerous for passengers. It is worth noting that the exploitation of lithium-ion batteries does not only negatively affect the environment but also human health. Problems such as skin allergy and Pulmonary dysfunction exist. Lithium-ion batteries are widely employed in electric vehicles now: companies such Tesla, Boeing, Airbus, and NASA are doing research in this field of lithium-ion batteries and have already produced many products with a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic pricing strategy of electric vehicle charging based on game theory under user demand service scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Under the goal of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, the electric vehicle (EV) industry has ushered in important development opportunities. With the large-scale growth of the number of EVs, the various charging needs of users should be taken into account in the game of interests between EV users and charging station operators. Based on this, this paper proposes a dynamic pricing strategy of EV charging based on game theory under the user demand service scheme. While considering the orderly charging of EVs, this strategy designs a service scheme for users with charging needs, and combines the user service utility model to establish a game pricing model in different scenarios, and finally solves the optimal pricing strategy. The data simulation results show that the model can effectively solve user needs, improve user service quality, and achieve a win-win situation for charging station operators and EV users.

articleTitle: Finite element simulation of reactor vibration and noise based on multi physical field coupling
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Aiming at the noise radiation and propagation problem in the external sound field of power reactor, a simplified reactor model was established using ANSYS workbench, and the simulation model was imported into the acoustic software LMS virtual.lab, and the finite element mesh was divided by the direct boundary element method, the vibration of the reactor surface is simulated and calculated, finally, the characteristics of the noise radiation and the sound field are analyzed, and the noise value around the reactor is predicted to show that the sound diffraction phenomenon is very strong, the sound pressure value changes rapidly, and the relevant results can provide a corresponding theoretical basis for reactor noise reduction.

articleTitle: Application research of 3D laser scanning technology in hull rib assembly
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The traditional measurement methods and techniques cannot satisfy the accuracy requirements of the floor pull-in method, which is mainly manifested in the incomplete measurement data and low efficiency. To some extent, it restricts the actual demand for floor pulling in assembly. Based on this, this paper discusses the application of 3D laser scanning technology and virtual simulation technology in the assembly accuracy management of hull rib plates. The acquisition and processing method of rib point cloud data based on 3D laser scanning is studied. Rib error detection and virtual assembly simulation research were carried out based on a reverse model. Good application results have been achieved. This research provides a new way and technical means to realize fast detection and predictive correction of assembly errors during rib assembly, which can provide reference and technical support for improving the accuracy and success of the floor pull-in method.

articleTitle: Bearing fault diagnosis method based on CEEDMAN-LDA-DBN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: According to the problem of rolling bearing fault features and difficult to identify fault identification, a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on set empirical mode decomposition (CEEMDDAN), linear discriminant analysis (LDA), and deep belief network (DBN) mode recognition is proposed. This method first decomposes the original sampling signal through CEEMDAN-SVD, obtains the inherent mode component (IMFS) from high frequency to low frequency, selects the intrinsic mode (IMF) component that best represents the original signal, and then constructs the reduced feature parameters into the feature vector, and finally establishes a DBN classification model to realize the identification of bearing fault type. Simulation results show that the fault recognition rate of the rolling bearing has reached 98.33%, indicating that the model has high accuracy and stability.

Author Keywords: complementary overall average empirical mode decomposition

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Interactive Electronic Technology Manual for Electric Multiple Units
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the unstructured traditional management mode of the technical data of Electric Multiple Units (EMU) in my country has gradually failed to meet the needs of EMU operation and maintenance support, this paper studies the application of the Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) for EMU. According to the demand analysis of the EMU IETM system, the EMU IETM system is designed based on the B/S architecture, supported by the IETM production subsystem, the IETM content management subsystem, and the IETM browsing display subsystem. The key technologies and functions of the three systems are researched and designed. The EMU IETM system can digitally manage the technical data of the EMU, which is in line with the trend of modern digital development. It will greatly improve the level of EMU operation and maintenance support.

articleTitle: Experimental study on dynamic transmission accuracy of RV reducer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The transmission error is a critical evaluation index of the transmission accuracy of the RV reducer. In this paper, based on the RV reducer comprehensive performance testing platform, the transmission error under different working conditions is experimentally tested. The results show that the transmission error is 57.467” at no-load and 64.299” at 100Nm and 100rpm. Under the variable load condition, the transmission error at different rotational speeds increases with load increase. The higher the rotation speed, the greater the degree of influence on the error.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Suspension Geometric Parameters of Formula Student Race Vehicle Based on ADAMS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Based on the formula student race vehicle, this paper takes the suspension system of Wuhan University of Technology formula student racecar as the research object. After establishing the dynamic model of the front suspension in ADAMS, the dynamic simulation is carried out. From the perspective of handling and stability, the sensitivity analysis and optimization design of the kingpin parameters are carried out with the change of wheel grounding angle and steering force as the optimization objectives. After that, the vehicle lap speed is simulated based on VI-CarRealTime, and the vehicle static camber is simulated and optimized. The research results show that the steering wheel righting torque of the optimized car during steering is effectively reduced to a reasonable range, and the change rate and amplitude of wheel inclination to road plane are reduced, which achieves the design goal and improves the handling performance of the car. At the same time, it is matched with the static camber to ensure the good adhesion between the tire and the ground.

articleTitle: Research on Calculation Method of Traffic Stations Scale of Comprehensive Transportation Hub
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Scientifically determining the scale of various traffic connection facilities plays an important role in the design of comprehensive transportation hub. Taking Shengzhou Xinchang high-speed railway station as an example, this paper firstly puts forward the traffic functions of various connecting facilities in the front square of the station. Secondly, according to the relevant design data of the high-speed railway station, the “Logit Model” is used to predict the proportion of various travel modes in Shengzhou urban area in the future, and then the transferring passenger flow in peak hours among transportation modes in the future year are obtained. Thirdly, it states the scale calculation methods to compute the scale of multiple traffic station facilities. Finally, the calculation results shall be optimized and adjusted to obtain the optimal hub layout. According to the connection principle, layout form and traffic streamlines of different traffic modes.

articleTitle: Low-voltage active distribution network fault location system considering information distortion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The low-voltage active distribution network has a large number and short length of line sections. and due to the complex operating environment, the monitoring information uploaded by the terminal may be distorted. The existing fault section location algorithm has low solution efficiency and low accuracy. In this paper, an objective function to deal with information distortion is designed, and a fault location system for 380v power grid considering information distortion is proposed, and improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve it. The dynamic model experiment platform is built, the dynamic model experiment proves that the positioning result of the proposed system is accurate.

articleTitle: Rigid-flexible coupling dynamics modeling and sensitive factor analysis of tracked vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Tracked vehicles are widely used in agriculture, military, construction and other fields because of their high passability, super climbing ability and high traction, and their dynamic performance directly determines the ride comfort and running stability of the vehicle. Identifying the sensitive factors that affect the dynamic characteristics of tracked vehicles has important engineering value in improving the dynamic performance of the vehicle. In this paper, the dynamic modeling and sensitive factor analysis of the tracked vehicle are carried out. Focus on the different flexibility treatment methods, road slope, speed and other parameters of the tracked body and balance elbow, and discuss the influence of different factors on the dynamic performance. The results show that the compliance of the balance bend and the body in the rigid-flexible coupled model will lead to changes in the equivalent stiffness and damping of the entire body, resulting in significant changes in the dynamic response. The acceleration response is greatly affected by the high frequency mechanism, and the pitch angle response is greatly affected by the low frequency mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on self-healing function of smart distribution network based on adaptive genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Based on the impact of the uncertainty of distributed power supply output and load on the distribution network tide, a distribution network post-fault self-healing model is established considering factors such as supply capacity, load priority, network loss and operation loss. An improved adaptive genetic algorithm is proposed, which adopts the initial population generation based on loop unbundling. The algorithm performs coding and genetic operations for distribution network structure characteristics to avoid generating infeasible solutions, and finally obtains the target optimal distribution network self-healing scheme. The IEEE33 node distribution network architecture is used as an example for simulation, and the proposed algorithm is verified to be higher efficient and stable in finding the optimal solution. At the same time, the network structure is changed through self-healing, which can effectively reduce the reduction of network loss.

articleTitle: Heat dissipation optimization design of container structure in submarine data center
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: the big data center is mainly built in China's inland areas. While occupying a lot of land, cooling and heat dissipation need to consume a lot of electric energy and cooling water resources, and the heat dissipation effect is not good. This paper presents the heat dissipation optimization design of the container structure of the submarine data center. Through the reference and analysis of the original container model structure of Seabed Data Center, the rectangular fin radiator structure is adopted, and the radiator thermal resistance network model is established for the establishment of radiator thermal resistance model. Comparative analysis under the initial conditions that the size of the data center container is a cylinder with a diameter of 1m and a length of 12M, the maximum heat dissipation power of the original model is 65677w, while the maximum heat dissipation power of the new model with rectangular fin radiator structure is 70000w. Therefore, the new structure of rectangular fin radiator makes the heat dissipation effect better, solves the problem of saving energy to a certain extent, and has good practical value, It provides a basis for the heat dissipation design of submarine data center system.

articleTitle: Research on the Collaborative Optimization of Configuration and Scheduling Strategy of All Renewable Energy Multi-energy Complementary System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: the design of a set of all renewable energy multi-energy complementary coupling energy supply system is made to realize the goal of “double carbon” and increase the proportion of renewable energy consumption. For the user side, it conducts the load simulation calculation and resource endowment analysis. Through the comprehensive consideration on the economy and environmental protection of the system, the multi-objective mixed integer linear programming method and Lingo software are used to establish the coordinated optimization model of system capacity allocation and energy scheduling strategy. The optimal capacity configuration and energy dispatching strategy of each unit of the system were obtained. The optimal capacity allocation of an all renewable energy multi-energy complementary coupled energy supply system to meet the cooling, heating and power load of a 500-unit household in Helingeer County is found. These are 1850 kW for the biogas power unit, 2900 kW for the wind power unit, 1000 kW for the photovoltaic unit, 5100 kW for the gas-fired lithium bromide air conditioning unit, and 1920 kW for the electricity storage unit.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of protection method for buried pipelines crossing joints under uncoordinated deformation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Because of the buried pipelines are likely to be failure when they are subjected to offset at the interface of two blocks, two protection methods (steel casing and soft casing) are proposed to reduce the failure of buried pipelines crossing the construction joints of concrete base. Then, the numerical simulation was carried to study the deformation and stress of the buried pipeline subjected to the joint movement, as well as the effect of two pipe protection methods on reduce pipe failure. The results reveal that the maximum tensile and compression stress of the pipeline are distributed at the joint, and the compressive stress is obviously larger, which will induce the bending failure. Furthermore, the maximum tensile and compressive stress of the pipe increase linearly with the increase of joint movement. The stress of pipe around the pipe is nonuniform, and it is larger at the top and bottom of pipe. The stress of the pipelines reduced significantly with the application of two pipe protection methods, and the effect of steel casing method is better to reduce the pipe failure at the joint.

articleTitle: Design of a Flower-like Deployable Pendant Lamp Inspired by Sarrus Linkage
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: This article analyzes the sketches and performs related mathematical calculations to design a flower-shaped expandable pendant lamp. The chandelier structure can illuminate the environment when unfolded and darken the atmosphere when retracted. Compared with the existing products, the structure has a smoother appearance design and greater scalability, enabling it to be integrated into romantic or modern decoration styles. At the same time, the simpler built-in Sarrus Linkage ring provides good reliability and durability.

articleTitle: Intelligent oil injection system for marine low-speed engine cylinder adapting to multi-fuel
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: At present, ships usually choose a larger oil injection rate to avoid pulling the cylinder with mechanical oil injector, which will result in high cylinder oil consumption rate. Bring pressure to the competition. The piston ring-cylinder liner friction force real-time measurement system studied in this paper is used to feed back to the cylinder oiler to form a marine low-speed diesel engine cylinder intelligent oiling system with frictional feedback. With accurate and fast cylinder fuel injection rate adjustment, the intelligent cylinder fuel injection system for marine low-speed engines adapts to various fuels, and achieves the purpose of reducing the consumption of fuel injection and reducing the emission of marine diesel engines.

articleTitle: An industrial mineral raw material classification method based on image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In the metallurgical industry, determining the raw material category is a critical step in the whole process. Manual detection methods are time-consuming and labor-intensive in distinguishing the different types of mixes. To solve the above issues, we proposed a mineral raw materials classification method based on the Unet++ image segmentation model. The model could identify and locate the areas of the material on the belt using a camera installed above the mineral raw material conveyor. Then the identified content was segmented to distinguish the different material types. A novel annotation method was designed to produce the dataset, which was never reported elsewhere in the metallurgical industry. This pixel-level segmentation method identified accurately particles down to 1mm in size. By comparing different loss functions, image sizes, and network structures, we proved the effectiveness of our model. Inference on the dataset achieved 92.86% precision.

articleTitle: Optimization of inverted ridge structure in GAN - based heterojunction laser
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The double heterojunction laser has the characteristics of low cost and high gain, which is suitable for use in various laser sources requiring miniaturisation. Among them, the ridge structure is one of the most straightforward schemes to improve optical performance. However, because the ridge structure etches part of the electrode, there is a tradeoff parameter in the design of the laser, that is, the tradeoff between optical and electrical properties. Therefore, we used Silvaco TCAD device simulation software to optimise the ridge structure's design further, focusing on various geometric and material parameters of the ridge structure, and finally came to an optimal solution. To highlight the optimisation ideas and provide guidance for a broader range of research directions, we did not consider overly detailed technological processes in all our work. Finally, the results show that the inverted ridge structure can effectively improve the electrical characteristics.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Air-open State Intelligent Monitoring Device Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The existing power supply monitoring system has incomplete information collection and cannot monitor the status of the DC power supply system circuit breaker. In recent years, there have been many equipment incidents caused by the failure of the DC distribution panel circuit breaker. This paper develops a machine learning-based air switch condition monitoring device, which closely combines the new generation of artificial intelligence technology with the actual work requirements of DC power supply system air switch monitoring and operation and maintenance, and uses machine learning to build an air switch wire shedding model to identify loose wires, Drop off and other hidden troubles, guide operation and maintenance to eliminate hidden troubles and other actual production problems. And the operation risk management and control will be inclined to advance. It can be used for real-time monitoring of the operating status of the air switch, early warning analysis of loose wires, falling off faults, and visual predictive operation and maintenance, which greatly improves the level of communication operation.

articleTitle: Saber Simulation Research of Flyback Switching Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In this paper, the principle circuit of the DC-DC convert for a Flyback switching power supply is constructed using the Saber Simulating platform. The implementation method on Flyback switching transformer is also given and the circuit working characteristics of the switching convert in two states of CCM or DCM are analyzed and calculated. Finally all simulation waveforms under two states are provided by using TR simulation tools of Saber.

articleTitle: Research on Design and Application of Automatic Unhooking Device
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In the current tower erection process, the constructor has to climb to the connecting rope position to manually unhook the rope after a section or part of a tower is hoisted, which involves substantial safety risks. An automatic unhooking device is studied in this paper based on the parameters of towers in engineering applications to ease working at height of constructors and improve their working safety. This device was designed in terms of structural form, drive mode, and remote control system. Its prototype was manufactured, tested, and applied to the 110kV wind power transmission project in Hongsibao, Ningxia, which achieved a satisfactory application result. The research results can provide a reference basis for the design of automatic unhooking devices and are of specific engineering significance.

articleTitle: Research on Composite Vibration Damping System Based on Adaptive Gasket
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: An adaptive small-scale mechanical vibration damping system based on hydraulic gasket is designed in this project. Its main function is to realize the active damping of small moving machinery and the self-adaptive automatic centering of shafting machinery. The system is mainly composed of hydraulic gasket, controller, sensor and external power source. The vibration damping device is small in size, suitable for use in small power machinery, has low cost, and has better applicability than the existing system. The vibration damping platform is designed with a unique hydraulic gasket based on a small power machine, and an active and passive composite vibration damping system is constructed. It has guiding significance for the vibration roduction design of machinery.

articleTitle: Mechanical structure optimization design of fiber Fabry-Perot pressure sensor sensitive diaphragm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In order to improve the sensing performance of optical fiber Fabry-Perot pressure sensor, this paper uses the finite element method to carry out the mechanical simulation of the silicon pressure sensitive diaphragm of the sensor, and studies the deformation deflection and linearity of several typical diaphragm structures under different pressures. Combined with theoretical analysis and simulation verification, a membrane structure of rectangular groove and cylindrical convex platform is proposed. Through theoretical analysis, the size parameter range that the structure can be used safely is determined and a dimensionless evaluation index that combines sensitivity, bending degree and linearity is constructed. Through the finite element simulation analysis, the film performance of the new structure is comprehensively improved compared with that of the flat structure. This study has certain guiding significance and reference value for the diaphragm design of optical fiber Fabry-Perot pressure sensor.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Energy Consumption Model Based on Working Condition Recognition and K-means Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In order to study the energy consumption of electric vehicles, this paper proposes to build a working condition recognition model, using principal component analysis and K-means clustering, comprehensively considering the basic attributes of the vehicle, road and environmental information, driving profile fragment information, accessory status and other factors, Perform feature extraction and cluster analysis of different operating conditions of electric vehicles to identify the operating conditions of different vehicles under the combined action of their internal control strategy characteristics and external factors. Combined with the optimized MGADNN neural network, based on the working condition recognition model, the main work module models are coupled to build the energy consumption prediction model of electric vehicles. The research provides references for enterprise research and development, vehicle control strategy management design, and user travel.

articleTitle: The Intelligent Human Sensory Interaction of a Wheelchair for the Elderly
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In this paper the human-computer interaction system of wheelchair for the elderly and the disabled is studied. The system is divided into three modes: follow mode, gesture control mode and manual control mode. The system uses Kinect to model the human skeleton, obtain the distance between the following object and the camera, and track the human motion; Use leap motion to obtain hand point cloud data, recognize user gestures, obtain hand displacement information in space, and control wheelchair movement; The pressure sensors on both sides of the wheelchair armrest are used to wirelessly transmit the push of medical staff to the wheelchair through the HC-12 module, which can better help medical staff reduce physical consumption, especially when going uphill.

articleTitle: Research on automatic control and multifunctional recycling system of condensed water based on split air conditioner
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In the room where the air conditioner is turned on for a long time, due to the reduction of humidity, a large amount of water in the upper respiratory tract mucosa of the human body will be lost, and people will feel dry mouth, and even have symptoms such as sore throat, hoarseness, and nosebleeds, and are prone to colds. Therefore, we also designed a purification and humidification system for air-conditioning condensed water, so that the utilization of condensed water can be integrated. The system not only solves the environmental pollution caused by the random discharge of condensed water from the air conditioner, but also effectively reduces the energy consumption of the air conditioner and saves water.

articleTitle: Research on Forming Optimization of Pneumatic Support Rod Fixing Plate of Car Tailgate Based on Orthogonal Test
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Taking a new energy car tailgate pneumatic support rod fixing plate as the object, the simulation model is established by AutoForm finite element analysis software, and the stamping and forming numerical simulation is performed on it. On the basis of orthogonal experiment, the influence of drawbead width, convex and concave die gap, blank holder force, friction coefficient on the springback of the workpiece in the normal direction is studied by the range analysis method combined with the variance analysis method. Then the process parameter scheme with the best forming quality is obtained, which provides a theoretical basis for subsequent actual production.

articleTitle: Research on Cavitation Resistance by Vortex in Water Hydraulic Valves
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Cavitation is a major failure in water hydraulic valve causing noise, vibration and destruction of material. Many experiments have found that bubbles are not easily formed and exploded near the vortex flow field. For reducing cavitation of water hydraulic valves, based on an original valve, 3 structures models about forming vortex flow field were designed including jet hole structure, spiral groove structure, and combining jet hole and spiral groove structure. Using a computational fluid dynamics approach, adopting to the Mixture model as multiphase flow model and the Full Cavitation model as cavitation model, the relationship between formation of cavitation bubbles and vortex flow field were numerically analyzed. The effects of vortex flow field and the structure forming it was simulated. Compared with original valves, formation and distribution of cavitation, the law of bubble mass transition, and analysis of different flow fields were discussed in this paper. This investigation shows that vortex flow field and the structure forming vortex flow field can improve cavitation resistance in water hydraulic valve.

articleTitle: Coupled numerical simulation of stress-hydraulics-mechanics for buried pipelines in Baihetan Dam drainage corridors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The deformation of buried pipeline caused by the construction, such as backfill, compaction, and excavation, has attracted increasing research attention recently. And the previous researches of continuous pipelines are aimed at tunneling-induced deformation. In this paper, a numerical study is conducted to investigate the response of pipelines induced by the rise of underground water table, which are buried in concrete bottom plates in drainage gallery in Baihetan hydropower station. In this simulation, special attention to the influence of the joint between every two concrete bottom plates is devoted. The results show that the rise of underground water will cause the rebound deformations of concrete bottom plate and the tensile strains in adjacent pipeline. Besides, setting joint between two concrete bottom plates will lead to the changes of pore water pressure along the length direction, which will cause the smaller deformation and larger compression and tensile stress in pipelines at the place of joint. The induced stress around the pipe is nonuniform due to the uneven distribution of the pore water pressure in the concrete bottom plates. Since the small rebound deformation of concrete bottom plate induced by the increase of pore water pressure, the increase of the pipe stress is limited, and the buried pipelines can be operated normally.

articleTitle: Working state analysis of one-way valve in high pressure tubing with MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: We established a fitting model to determine the optimal duration of each opening of the single-shot valve when the high-pressure oil pipeline is operating steadily. Using the collected data, the functional relationship between elastic modulus and pressure was obtained by fitting with MATLAB. By analyzing the differential equation of the separable variables, the optimal duration of each opening of the single valve was obtained. And by comparing the elastic modulus fitting and the real value curve, the consistency of the model and the actual value is verified. Considering the time requirement for adjusting the tubing pressure in the actual production process, we established an optimization model to determine the length of time for the check way valve to open when the tubing pressure is increased from 100MPa to 150MPa within two seconds and stabilized.

articleTitle: Sampling point planning method for thin-walled blades considering processing deformation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In this paper, a sub-regional sampling point planning method considering processing deformation is proposed. First, the number of sections and the position of the blade section curve are determined. Second, the processing deformation of the blade is predicted, and the section curve is divided into regions according to the deformation size. Then, the chordal deviation value is set according to the corresponding curvature and processing deformation of each region, and the chordal deviation method is used to determine the sampling points. Finally, the measuring points in each region are comprehensively extracted, and the experimental verification is carried out. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional chordal deviation method without considering the processing deformation, the maximum deviation of the overall fitting of the blade is reduced by 59.33% and the average deviation is reduced by 16.50% when the total number of sampling points is reduced by 18.97%. The proposed method not only conforms to the blade curvature characteristics, but also matches the processing deformation, which improves the efficiency and accuracy of blade on-machine measurement.

articleTitle: Mechanical design of service robot arm based on TRIZ theory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In this study, a universal service manipulator is developed, which can be used as a remote control guide. The concept of new manipulator is obtained by bionics. The fingers and wrists are driven by wire ropes and actuators attached to the upper arm through a musculoskeletal analysis of the human arm. Through dc motor driven screw - nut mechanism, drive cable to produce high tension. In order to facilitate the control of ground breaking force, combined spring is used in screw - nut mechanism. In the first design, finger control problems and interference between finger and wrist movements were found. Through the contradiction analysis of tree, the solutions of these problems are obtained. For the second design, broken paper and motion tests were performed on objects of various shapes and weights.

articleTitle: Component Welding Defect Intelligent Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Components welding defect detection of PCB (Printed Circuit Board) is indispensable in PCB manufacturing process, which is the quality guarantee of electronic products. At present, there are I three difficult problems about PCB component defect detection in factory. Firstly, there are far more normal samples than negative samples because of difficulty in collecting negative samples. Secondly, industrial assembly line requires real-time performance, so that the detection model should be as tiny as possible. Thirdly, the factory often requires a 100% recall rate and a very low false positive rate, but these two indicators are mutually constrained. To solve the first problem, we use data rebalancing strategy to balance the dataset. On the one hand, we increase the number of negative samples by data augmentation technologies. On the other hand, we cluster the positive samples and appropriately remove some positive sample from each cluster. To solve the second problem, we designed a lightweight network that introduced feature fusion strategies to improve accuracy of detection. To solve the third problem, we will design an inter-class decision mechanism to make a second decision in the output of network. Finally, our model achieves better mAP of 99.90% than other methods on our dataset, and a 100% defect recall and 97.15% defect precision are achieved on the dataset provided by ZTE.

articleTitle: Study on Diagnosis Method of Conversion Efficiency of Three-way Catalytic Converter for Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The three-way catalytic converter has been widely used as an after-treatment device for gasoline engines and natural gas engines. Its conversion efficiency directly affects the engine emission results. Therefore, the conversion efficiency of the three-way catalytic converter is also required as a mandatory check item the OBD certification for such engines. Based on the relationship between oxygen storage capacity and conversion efficiency of three-way catalytic converter, this paper discusses and compares different methods and principles of three-way catalytic converter efficiency, and analyzes and studies the effects of different diagnostic methods on engine control, economy and emission performance, which has a certain reference value.

articleTitle: Study on calculation of wind deviation of transmission line by computational fluid dynamics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: As an important way to ensure power consumption, the wind deflection flashover of transmission line has a serious impact on industrial and daily power consumption. The value of wind deflection angle of insulator string in current design code is seriously small in calculating large span and multi span transmission line. Based on the equivalent static wind load theory, a calculation method of insulator string wind deflection angle considering pulsating wind effect is proposed. On the basis of rigid straight bar method, the equivalent static wind load on the conductor is simplified to the equivalent uniformly distributed load to calculate the wind deflection angle. The result show that the value of wind deflection angle considering pulsating wind effect is more reasonable.

articleTitle: Calculation of Electrical Energy Output from Co-firing Waste Syngas in Coal-fired Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Co-firing biomass in the present coal-fired power plant is the most efficiency way to dispose agroforestry waste. However, the co-firing experience achieved slow progress because of the vague rules of electricity calculation, which is the difficult part and relates to the financial subsidy. The national energy administration recently issued the calculation method and, in this article, detailed explanations of the method is introduced. The method can also be a reference or inspired ideas for power calculation of other co-firing facilities.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Physical Characteristic of the Westinghouse SMR Core Based on MCNP program
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In order to investigate the features of small advanced reactors, the model of Westinghouse SMR core was established through the reference parameters in IAEA, VERA-PWR benchmark and AP1000 design control documents. The physical parameters of SMR core were calculated by MCNP program and the results were compared with the design value of AP1000. The results show that the core model was correct. The parameters of the model and the calculation results could be used for SMR design and related nuclear safety evaluation studies.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent fault diagnosis and online monitoring technology of filling production line
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In view of a series of problems such as instabilities, breakdowns, and difficulty of manual maintenance in filling process of spray filling line, through in-depth study on health monitoring of spray filling production line, the research status of health monitoring and testing of spray filling production line in recent years has been summarized, and the research direction of health monitoring and fault diagnosis for filling production line has been summarized. It also introduces the new methods of health monitoring and fault diagnosis of filling production line and reliability analysis of filling capacity control mechanism, and puts forward the monitoring method of on-line recognition and early warning of abnormal signal of filling screw cap with binocular 3D vision technology.

articleTitle: Simulation of the effects of Activators on the Laser Welding of Stainless Steel Plate
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: This paper establishes a mathematical model for the laser welding with activator of stainless steel plate, and numerically analyzes the influence law of activator on the dynamic behavior of the fluid flow and the temperature field in the welding pool of stainless steel plate. The results show that the specimen coated with activator has a certain influence on the peak temperature of the welding pool. NaF activator reduces the peak temperature of the welding pool, while SiO2 and TiO2 both increase the maximum temperature of the welding pool, but neither of them changes the temperature distribution of the welding pool. And, the coating of activator changes its flow direction of fluid in the welding pool, that is, the fluid flows from the edge to the center. Meanwhile, the activator coating increases the flow velocity of fluid in the welding pool, the maximum velocity of flow fluid on the longitudinal section, upper surface and cross section at the same position of the specimen coated with SiO2 activator increases by 8%, 25.8% and 33.8% compared with no active agent, respectively.

articleTitle: Intelligent control strategy for cement production assisted by wind power generation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Sliding mode control considering disturbance compensation is proposed for permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) system. Firstly, the sliding mode control is carried out for the speed loop of PMSG to accurately control the speed. Secondly, considering the external disturbance, an extended state observer is used to estimate the disturbance, and the estimated value is used as feedforward signal to compensate the system. Finally, the simulation model for PMSG control system is built to verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Design of Master-slave Teleoperation Puncture System Based on Force Feedback
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In the field of minimally invasive surgery, medical robotics has always been a hot research topic. In this paper, targeted puncture surgery is taken as the research object and a complete master-slave remote operation puncture system is constructed for the lack of force feedback information of the operator during the operation. The master-slave mapping and control system of the modification system were designed, and then a complete puncture force model was established in the puncture process. Finally, the effectiveness of the system was proved by master-slave following experiment and simulated puncture experiment, and the operator could perceive the precise feedback puncture force.

articleTitle: Algorithm Optimization Applied in the Selection of Stress Distribution Supported by FLAC3D Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of rockburst happened during deep mining activity in Inner Mongolia area, FLAC3D numerical simulation software was used to analyze the supporting effect of different supporting methods. Through the analysis of the influence of the three methods of slot-tube anchor bar, resin bolt and bolt-mesh combined support on the stress, displacement and elastic strain energy distribution of roadway surrounding rock, it is found that the bolt-mesh combined support can effectively reduce the elastic strain energy and the potential of rock burst.

articleTitle: High-Performance Piezotronic Devices Based on ALN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Piezotronics and piezo-phototronics by adopting piezoelectric semiconductor (such as ZnO, GaN, InN, and monolayer MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) have received more and more interests in piezotronic strain sensor, self-powered sensor, and flexible devices. The strain generated piezoelectric charges can tune the carriers transport properties. We proposed a piezotronic M-S junction based on AIN. The electric characteristic (including Current-Voltage, Current-Strain), piezoelectric characteristic of piezotronic M-S junction is calculated by finite element method. The Gauge Factor of piezotronic M-S junction can reach over 2000 due to adjustion of piezotronic effect. This study not only enrich theory of piezotronics, and provide guidance for experiments of piezotronic devices.

articleTitle: A Measurement Method of Mineral Raw Material Intensity Based on Image Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In the metallurgical industry, online monitoring of belt conveyors' mineral raw material flow intensity helps avert severe accidents during production. There is no established method for detecting mineral raw material flow intensity in real time using computer-based technologies. So, we proposed two computer vision processing methods: traditional image processing algorithm approach and a CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks) MobileNetV2-SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector) detection method based on deep learning. We created a dataset containing 5731 images and experimented it on both methods, and also assessed it on different convolutional neural network models. In summary, the conventional image processing algorithm holds an accuracy of 81.68%, whereas the MobileNetV2- SSD model exhibited 99.65% accuracy. The MobileNetV2-SSD reflected significant advantages over other models in terms of accuracy and time consumption. So, we conclude that MobileNetV2-SSD mineral raw material flow intensity detection model can be widely used in metallurgical production to automate the production process and improve productivity.

articleTitle: Moment Test Technique of the Aircraft's Water Rudder Hinge Based on Structural Loads
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: By studying the maneuvering principle of water rudder structure and mechanical characteristics, two approaches to the torque test of water rudder hinge, including rocker arm bending moment and rotating shaft torque based on the principle of moment balance, are used. And the test scheme of the rocker arm bending moment is determined by analyzing the test principle, feasibility, period and other factors. Moreover, the optimal measurement point evaluation based on model analysis, fiber grating sensing temperature compensation, and the test performance optimization scheme are designed. The test flight results show that the rocker arm's reliable bending moment data are obtained through structural load-strain test. Besides, the test accuracy reaches 0.3% which meets the demand for water rudder moment test in actual scenarios.

articleTitle: Identification Method of Motor Bearing Fault Location and Degree Based on Quadratic Discriminant Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The fault diagnosis of rolling bearings is of great significance to improve the efficiency of industrial production and ensure the stable and safe operation of industrial production. In order to improve the accuracy rate of rolling bearing fault location identification and analyze the fault degree, a fault diagnosis method of motor bearing based on the quadratic discriminant analysis method is proposed. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional intelligent algorithm, the model takes the original vibration signal as the research object and can perform fault location diagnosis and fault degree analysis without going through complex feature extraction procedures. Moreover, with the increased number of vibration samples points, the accuracy of the diagnosis also continues to improve. Finally, comparing the quadratic discriminant analysis method with other intelligent algorithms, it is found that when the vibration sample length is 80, the quadratic discriminant analysis method improves the diagnostic accuracy by 44.2% on average and shortens the training time by 87.5% on average compared with other methods.

articleTitle: Corona Discharge Ion Wind Propulsion System Model Based on COMSOL
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: With the development of electric power technology, more and more vehicles are developing towards electric propulsion. Moreover, as aerospace is its frontier development field, electric propulsion technology also has excellent development advantages. In order to study the influence of the power source of electric propulsion on the effect of electric propulsion, we established a corona discharge ion wind propulsion system model based on COMSOL simulation by analogy with a two-dimensional wind tunnel model. In addition, we simplified the model and selected negative ions as a gas medium to conduct stable state simulation, and studied the relationship between voltage, the distance between electrode and airfoil, the radius of curvature of wire, and ionic wind thrust in order to provide a reference for subsequent research on optimization of electric propulsion system. Through the parameterization of the model, we find that the thrust increases gradually with the increase of voltage. As the horizontal distance between electrode and airfoil increases, the thrust decreases. With the increase in radius of curvature of the wire electrode, the thrust force increases gradually.

articleTitle: The intelligent detection and separation of geometric errors of four-axis CNC machine tool turntable
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: When the CNC machine tool turntable rotates, geometric errors in the direction of 6 degrees of freedom were produced. Traditional measurement methods mainly measure the error of a degree of freedom alone, which have problems of low detection efficiency, troublesome operation and inconvenient field test. This paper presented a method for fast separation of six geometric errors of turntable, which was based on THM46100 high-precision four-axis horizontal machining center. To confirm the validity of the proposed method, the filed test was conducted. This paper first introduced the identification model of six-degree-of-freedom errors of the CNC machine tool turntable. Then, with the help of the ball-bar device, the geometric error detection and separation experiment of the turntable were carried out, and the three displacement errors and three angle errors are identified. As a result, the proposed method had the advantages of simple operation, high detection efficiency and suitable for field test.

articleTitle: Automation Control Module of Power System of Scientific Research Ship
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Ship transportation plays an important role in global transportation, and the safety and stability of the ship's power system is an important guarantee for the safety of ship transportation. Based on the development of large-scale and multi-functional ships, a power station automation control system with high reliability and complete functions is designed. Based on the actual load situation and operating requirements of a certain electric ship, the paper designs and establishes the radial and ring power network topologies of the ship, and then applies the PSAT power system analysis software to switch heavy loads on these two power grid topologies. The transient stability during the two processes of the short-circuit fault and the short-circuit fault are compared and analyzed. The simulation results show that the ring network topology has a stronger ability to supply power to the starboard and the starboard under the fault.

articleTitle: Research on the prediction method of lithium-ion battery remaining life based on EMD-Arima
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: A method for predicting the remaining life of lithium batteries based on empirical mode decomposition and Arima regression is proposed. After decomposing the remaining capacity data of lithium-ion batteries by EMD, the trend item of lithium battery degradation is selected from the decomposed features, and an Arima model is constructed and predicted for a single trend item. The experimental results show that EMD can significantly improve the model trained by Arima, and the method has certain reliability.

articleTitle: Experimental study of piezoelectric microfluidic hybrid pump with double-inlet and double-chamber
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In order to investigate the factors affecting the fluid mixing ratio in the piezoelectric hybrid pump, so as to make a reference for designing the piezoelectric hybrid pump that can accurately adjust the fluid mixing ratio, this paper analyzes the factors affecting the fluid mixing ratio of the piezoelectric pump and proposes a piezoelectric microfluidic hybrid pump with double-inlet and double-chamber. On the basis of analyzing the working principle of liquid transfer and liquid mixing of this piezoelectric pump, the effect of the different heights of the pump chamber on both sides of the piezoelectric pump on the input liquid flow rate on both sides and the effect of the different depth of the seal groove at the piezoelectric vibrator on the input liquid flow rate on both sides are experimentally investigated. The experiments show that the different depths of the seal grooves on both sides of the double-inlet double-chamber piezoelectric pump will cause changes in the inlet suction flow on both sides, and in the range of 30 to 110Hz, the flow rate difference between the two inlets can be up to 10ml/min; there exists a pump chamber with a better performance of 1mm in height, one side with a pump chamber height of The results show that the different seal groove depth and pump chamber depth on both sides of the piezoelectric pump will make the suction flow on both sides different, which has good reference value for the study of adjusting the mixing ratio.

articleTitle: Optimal design of converter valve back-check loop architecture in HVDC power transmission system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The structure of the converter valve back-check circuit in the HVDC transmission system is explained, and the impact of the failure of the optical receiving board and the restriction on the operation reliability of the high-voltage DC system are analyzed, and the new optical receiving board and optical splitter are proposed. The optimized architecture of the new architecture and the feasibility of the implementation of the new architecture have been fully discussed, explaining its rationality, effectiveness and generalizability.

articleTitle: Multi-class Motor Imagery Recognition of Single Joint in Upper Limb Based on Bispectrum
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulties in extracting effective features and low classification accuracy in the current multiclass motor imagery recognition, this paper proposes a multiclass motor imagery recognition method based on bispectrum analysis and twin support vector machine (TWSVM). First, the bispectrum analysis method is used to extract the features of the signal; finally, the features are sent to TWSVM for classification of the EEG, obtain an average recognition rate of 78.57%, which provides an effective method for multi-class motor imagery recognition, which will greatly pro-mote in practical application based on BCI.

articleTitle: Study on the Reflector Adjustment Model of Chinese Sky Eye-FAST Radio Telescope
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Compared with other large aperture radio telescopes of the same type, Chinese Sky Eye has three major advantages: active reflector technology, excellent geographical location, and light cable drag mechanism, among which active reflector technology is the core of the three advantages. It plays an essential role in observing celestial bodies. Therefore, this paper takes the total expansion of the actuator as small as possible as the objective function and establishes the reflection panel adjustment model under the constraint conditions that the distance between the adjacent nodes does not exceed 0.07%, and the radial expansion of the actuator does not exceed 0.6 meters. Finally, 706 nodes are in the paraboloid.

articleTitle: Research on Focal Position Model of Active Reflector of FAST Radio Telescope
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: This paper focuses on modeling the Chinese Tianyan FAST system. Taking the total expansion of the actuator and the smooth transition between the paraboloid edge and the sphere as the objective function, the ideal paraboloid model is established under the constraint conditions that the distance between the adjacent nodes does not exceed 0.07%, the radial expansion of the actuator is less than 0.6 meters and the focal length change within a certain range. The method of the definite integral is used to minimize the total expansion of the actuator, and the transition between the paraboloid edge and the sphere is smooth by minimizing the expansion change between the paraboloid edge and the sphere. The parabola focus is divided into the fixed single-parameter and unfixed two-parameter models. The calculation and analysis are carried out by combining the results and conditions of the two models. The focus fixed model is optimized.

articleTitle: Strain Measurement Method of Optical Fiber Composite Overhead Line Based on Least-squares Fit
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of measured strain for optical fiber composite overhead line, a strain measurement method based on the pseudo-Voigt profile and least-squares fit is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the principle of Brillouin scattering-based distributed optical fiber strain measurement method is presented. Secondly, the improved quadratic polynomial fit is used to calculate the initial value of variables. Thirdly, the objective function and optimization process of the least-squares fit are presented. Finally, the Brillouin spectra of the optical fiber composite overhead line with different values of SNR (signal-to-noise ratio) are numerically generated, and the corresponding Brillouin frequency shift (BFS) and strain are calculated by using the proposed method. The results show that the pseudo-Voigt profile-based least-squares fit can effectively approximate Brillouin spectrum under different values of frequency sweep span deviation and SNR, and the accuracy in BFS and strain is guaranteed. This work provides a high precision method for strain measurement of optical fiber composite overhead line.

articleTitle: Research Status of Solar Cell Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Solar energy is renewable, pollution-free and clean. Using photovoltaic cells to convert solar energy into electric energy is one of the important ways to use solar energy. In recent years, the conversion efficiency is increasing, and the application field of solar cells is becoming broad. This paper summarizes the internal structure, physical parameters and research progress of solar cells. First, the internal structure of solar cells, such as carrier transport and P-N junction, are introduced. Secondly, according to the structure of solar cells, some important physical parameters like IV curve, short circuit current, open circuit voltage, fill factor and efficiency of solar cells are summarized. Finally, the advantages, disadvantages like the optical loss of photogenerated current, the collection efficiency of photogenerated carriers and the actual factors affecting open circuit voltage, and research progress of traditional and new solar cells are introduced, and the development prospects of solar cells are prospected.

articleTitle: Sensorless control of permanent magnet synchronous motors based on high frequency square wave injection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: High-frequency (HF) carrier injection method has become a hot spot in the study of permanent magnet synchronous motor sensor less (PMSM) control technology. However, there are problems such as low precision and large interference in extracting rotor position information by traditional band-pass filter. An improved method is proposed, which is to introduce a second-order generalized integrator (SOGI) into the signal extraction process. It is a filter that can extract or eliminate specific frequency components. Due to its structural characteristics, it has a fast response capability. Therefore, the second-order generalized integrator is employed to acquire the rotor position component, and the position errors is gained by the heterodyne method, Luenberger Observers are employed to estimate velocity and position information. Finally, the superiority and correctness of the improved method are proved by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Study on Tension Leg Platform's Motion Response by Wave Load of 2nd-order Difference Frequency Based on Intelligent Computation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The performance requirements of all kinds of intelligent computation is increasing with the 5G and big data developed rapidly. Tension Leg Platform is one of the most important marine engineering equipment, it has good motion response performance under the marine environment load. In this paper, the searching process of the modern intelligent computation algorithms are studied, the programs which could be fit for different structural calculate problems, and the wave load of 2nd-order difference frequency of a TLP with a working water depth of 400m is calculated by intelligent computation algorithms. The results show that the longitudinal displacement is close to 8m, about 2% of the water depth when the period is 30-35s, showing obvious compliance. However, it has little effect on the out-of-plane motion of TLP, which can be almost ignored.

articleTitle: Research on Ship Sway Reduction Control Method Based on Model-Free Adaptive Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: When a ship sailing at sea is disturbed by ocean wind and wave currents, the transverse rocking motion has the greatest influence on the ship. The severe transverse rocking motion not only prevents the crew from working normally, but also may lead to the failure of equipment and instruments, and may even lead to the occurrence of ship accidents, causing significant losses such as environmental pollution and property and life. Based on this current situation, this paper researches a ship rocking reduction control method based on model-free adaptive control technology based on ship motion model, which can effectively realize the purpose of controlling ship rocking under wind and wave conditions based on model-free adaptive control algorithm and PID control system, and lays a certain theoretical foundation for the field of ship rocking reduction.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Evaluating Method of Leakage Current of Porcelain Insulators
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: To explore the essential relation between insulator leakage current and influence factors, the genetic algorithm (GA) combined with the Least square method (LSM) is used to obtain the relationship of the leakage current <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{I_{\mathrm{h}}}$</tex>, the relative humidity density RH, the equivalent salt deposit density <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\rho_{\text{EDSS}}}$</tex> and the applied voltage <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{U}$</tex>. Firstly, artificial pollution tests were carried out on single suspension insulator, waveforms of leakage current were recorded by a leakage current monitoring system under different operating conditions. Then the function relationship of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{RH,\rho_{\text{EDSS}},U}$</tex>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{I_{\mathrm{h}}}$</tex> was obtained by the GA and the LSM respectively. The result shows that when the leakage current is greater than 10 mA, the leakage current can be accurately estimated by GA, while when the leakage current is less than 10 mA, the LSM can estimate the leakage current more quickly. Finally, a new method for estimating leakage current is obtained by combining the GA with the LSM. The research results provide a reference for the evaluation of leakage current pollution degree in engineering.

articleTitle: A New Type Parametric Structural Design of Giant-magnetostrictive Disc Brake
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The brake is an important component in the braking system of a vehicle, and its excellent performance can effectively improve the safety of people traveling and reduce traffic accidents. In this paper, combined with the advantages of fast response and high energy of giant magnetostrictive materials, a driver is designed as an energy source for disc brakes to replace traditional braking media such as brake hydraulic pressure and motor. Under the conditions of reasonable design, the response speed can reach the microseconds level, shorten the braking response time, and improve the braking efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Quality Inspection and Intelligent Detection System of Mechanical Products by Computer Electronic Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: This paper designs a product quality inspection and development system based on computer electronic information technology. This paper firstly presents the business flow chart, data flow chart, control flow chart, and system hardware structure diagram for system realization. Then this paper presents the software design technology in a Windows-based system. Specifically include workshop, testing equipment, sensors, and application development technology based on the Silver database. Through system simulation, it is found that these technologies make the detection system have the advantages of simple operation and reliable operation.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Trigger Circuit Structure of Converter Valve in HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Describes the converter valve trigger circuit architecture in the HVDC system, analyzes the impact of component failures on the circuit, and proposes a new trigger circuit architecture with additional trigger fibers and MSC modules, and implements the new architecture The feasibility was fully discussed, explaining its practicability and generalizability.

articleTitle: TASEP model on a crossing of microtubules
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The totally asymmetric simple exclusion process (TASEP) on a crossing of microtubules has been studied. This 3-dimentional structure has been unwrapped into an ensemble of 1-dimensional or quasi-1-dimensional trajectories. We used mean field method to give the compound densities and currents. On this basis, the phase diagram of the compounds can be obtained. We structured such ‘sweeps’ in the entrance rate α, for fixed exit rate β and got the discontinuous densities and continuous currents.

articleTitle: First-Principles Calculations of Bi2Te2 and its Application in Ultrafast Fiber Lasers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the energy band, the density of states, and optical properties of the ternary compound <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Bi}_{2}\text{Te}2 Se$</tex> by first-principles calculations. It is proved that the material has good light absorption properties. Further, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Bi}_{2}\text{Te}2 Se$</tex> nanosheets were prepared by a hydrothermal method and used as a saturable absorber in an ultrafast fiber laser, achieving a stable mode-locked pulse output with 1566 nm at a pump power of 32.6 mW. When pump power reaches 116.5 mW, a stably bound state pulse appears in the laser. This study demonstrates that the material is a potential high-performance saturable body, which provides a possibility for developing ultrafast fiber lasers.

articleTitle: Study on Energy Efficiency of 35MWth Oxygen-fuel Boiler with Recirculated Flue Gas
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: A oxygen-fuel boiler working at O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> atmosphere can enrich the carbon dioxide for exhaust flue gas with recycled flue gas and injected oxygen as combustion supporting gas instead of air, which makes the calculation methods of flue gas distribution, exhaust gas loss and boiler efficiency different. A flue gas distribution analysis model considering air leakage is built for the actual operation of a O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> combustion boiler with designed thermal load of 35MWth. Based on the flue gas distribution model, the method calculating the exhaust flue gas loss is proposed which can be used to in boiler efficiency test. And then the boiler efficiencies of that boiler working at O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> atmosphere and air atmosphere are test and calculated. The calculation results show that the method of calculating the exhaust flue gas heat loss can be used correctly to analyze the oxygen-fuel combustion boiler test. The exhaust gas heat loss of 35MWth boiler under oxygen-fuel combustion mode is less than that under air combustion mode. But the solid incomplete combustion loss under oxygen-fuel combustion mode is greater than that under air combustion mode.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on a Burning Accident of Electromagnetic Unit of Capacitive Voltage Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Capacitive voltage transformer is an important protection and metering equipment in power system, its reliable and stable operation has an important impact on the safety of power grid, therefore, the research and fault analysis of capacitive voltage transformer is of great significance to ensure the safety of power grid. In this article, an investigation and research on a burning accident of 66kV capacitive voltage transformer electromagnetic unit is carried out, through on-site inspection, principle analysis, electrical test and disassembly inspection, the occurrence process of the accident is deduced, and the specific causes of the accident are obtained. Finally, according to the causes of the accident, targeted preventive measures are given to avoid the recurrence of such accidents, which provides an important reference for the construction technology and fault analysis of the same type of capacitive voltage transformer.
