articleTitle: Virtual Prototype Design of Double-station Welding Robot Workstation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The condensers in the existing refrigerator are welded by the traditional manual welding method, which is largely limited by the proficiency and operation status of the workers. The strong arc light and smoke dust pollution produced during welding have certain harm to the health of the operator. The resulting welds are short, discontinuous and of uneven width, and the welding quality is not easy to be guaranteed. By comparison, welding by using a welding robot not only effectively ensures the welding quality, but also works continuously and efficiently in harsh environments. For the welding requirements of condenser to be welded, a dual-position arc welding robot workstation is developed on the basis of welding robot, using double robot, positioner and pressure loading mechanism to jointly control the assembly and welding operation of condenser. This project has important theoretical significance and application value.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of machine tool eccentric drive feed system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In order to study the dynamic characteristics and eccentricity of machine tool eccentric drive feed system, this paper presents a 5-dof lumped parameter model. The dynamic equations of the model are derived and natural frequencies of the system are solved, the finite element modal analysis is used to verify, and the electromechanical coupling model is established in combination with the motor control part. The results show that theoretical analysis results and finite element analysis results have a good agreement, the 5-dof model can effectively describe the dynamic characteristics of the feed system, and when the eccentricity is greater than 0.5, the stability of the feed system decreases significantly. The study provides a reference for the engineering application of eccentric drive feed system.

articleTitle: Research on the Correlation and Intelligent Detection of Mechanical Response of Crash Dummy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In order to study the mechanical response correlation of dummy chest in crash test, this paper analyzes the chest structure and chest stiffness of the most widely used HIII 50 percentile dummy and the most advanced Thor dummy. Also, it analyzes the difference of chest response between the two dummies under different direction of seat belt. The results show that the chest stiffness of HIII 50 percentile dummy is about 190N/mm-200N/mm in 50km/h frontal impact test. The chest stiffness of Thor dummy is as follows: the left upper chest stiffness is basically maintained at about 210N/mm-230N/mm; The chest stiffness of the right upper is basically maintained at about 110N/mm-120N/mm; The chest stiffness of the right lower is relatively stable and maintained at about 130N/mm-140N/mm. Meanwhile, when the dummy is located on the left and right of the front row, the chest stiffness of the HIII 50 percentile dummy has no relation with the direction of the seat belt. But the chest stiffness of Thor dummy is related to the direction of safety belt, and the chest stiffness of different positions is symmetrical.

articleTitle: Investigating the effect of distance between wheels and centroid on the steering performance of four-wheel vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Automobile's dynamic performance is very important in terms of both safety and user experience. When completing very basic tasks such as U-turn or lane-change, we can access the vehicle's dynamic performance through analyzing different parameters. For example, the variation of the slip angle, time required and horizontal & vertical displacement, where the slip angles indicate the stability of the car and time and displacement shows the control flexibility. Such performance parameters are closely related to the vehicle's position of centroid, which can also be interpreted as the distance between centroid and front/rear wheel of the vehicle. When designing the car, engine position as well as mechanical structures is going to affect the centroid-wheel distance. During this research, a simulation of the vehicle's dynamic performance is completed using python, where the effect of centroid-wheel distance is being investigated and mathematical models for such relationship are created. The research result shows that with fixed total vehicle length, the maximum vertical & horizontal displacement when completing the U-turn motion decreases as the centroid approaches to the rear wheel, while the vertical displacement for lane-change motion increases.

articleTitle: Research on flexible load scheduling terminal based on industrial Internet
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In view of the research and development problem of flexible load scheduling industrial Internet device, this study proposes the research and development of electrical characteristic identification measurement and control terminal of heat storage equipment. The hardware device is based on the real-time electrical volume data of heat storage equipment. It is a new intelligent online monitoring device that can measure the flexible load measurement data such as voltage effective value and current effective value in real time, comprehensively and accurately. The hardware device constructs the information intercommunication based on the physical connection, and provides a unified physical “bridge” for all kinds of distributed controllable resources to access the distribution network. Through the developed power demand response algorithm, the problem of orderly power consumption in peak period can be solved. The global sensing technology can accurately know the load regulation ability in real time, so the demand response from non-real-time to real-time response.

articleTitle: A Low Noise and Low Dissipative Front-end Circuit for Wearable ECG
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: A high-performance instrumentation amplifier used in a wearable electrocardiogram (ECG) acquisition system is presented in this paper. A 3-amplifier topology is applied to achieve the large input impedance with 180nm CMOS technology. Remarkably, an experiment found a crucial phenomenon that helps burn more current from amplifiers to reduce the noise, resulting in a deviation between calculated gain and actual gain at the same time. Moreover, a driven-right-leg module is also implemented to set the input common-mode range, thus improving the common mode rejection ratio. The simulation under standard 180nm CMOS technology shows that the bandwidth ranges from 0.1Hz to 250 Hz. The front-end circuit operates under a 0.6V power source. In addition, for meeting different requirements, two versions of different total integrated input-referred noise and power dissipation are proposed respectively, the low-noise version with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${{3}{.47\mu VRMS}}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4.98{\mu}\mathrm{W}$</tex> and with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.47\mu \text{VRMS}$</tex> and the low-dissipation version with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.99\mu \text{VRMS}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.65\mu \mathrm{W}$</tex>. This paper's preliminary results lay an excellent theoretical foundation for the amplifier in ECG signal measurements.

articleTitle: Study on Mixed Lubrication Property of Planetary Gear Journal Bearing in Wind Turbine Gearbox
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Replacing the rolling bearings with journal bearings in the planetary gear of a high-power wind turbine gearbox can improve the power density of the gearbox, but it is unknown whether the journal bearing can achieve good load-bearing and lubrication under the condition of extremely low-speed and heavy-load. Therefore, the lubrication properties of the planetary gear journal bearing is investigated in this paper. Firstly, the viscosity-temperature equations of the special lubricating oils for wind turbine gearbox were determined by rheological test, and then a mixed lubrication model was established considering roughness, viscosity-temperature effect and elastic deformation of bearing bush lining-base composite material. The influence law of the bush relative clearance, roughness, different lubricating oils and inlet temperature, bearing diameter, lining material and thickness on the mixed lubrication properties of planetary journal bearing is obtained, which provides a theoretical basis for the design and application of planetary journal bearing in wind turbine gearboxes refer to.

articleTitle: Identification of fractures in Changning shale gas reservoir based on fast and slow S-wave remote detection imaging processing technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Fracture development is the key factor affecting shale gas bearing property and reservoir productivity. The fracture distribution of shale gas reservoir is identified by full wave energy attenuation of orthogonal dipole acoustic wave and S-wave far detection processing combined with logging data such as electrical imaging. Anisotropic processing is performed on the orthogonal dipole four component acoustic data to separate the fast and slow S-wave signals. According to the different responses of fast S-wave and S-wave to fractures in shale gas vertical wells and horizontal wells, the far detection processing technology is used to process and image the reflection signals of long-distance extended fractures outside the wellbore, so as to predict and evaluate the fracture development of a large number of shale gas exploration target layers in Changning area, The results show that fast and slow S-wave separation and S-wave remote detection imaging can better identify the fracture layer of a single well, which has guiding significance for the formulation of staged fracturing scheme of shale gas reservoir and shale gas exploration and development.

articleTitle: Off Design Performance Analysis of 35MWth Oxygen-fuel Combustion Boiler
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: In order to deeply understand the heat transfer characteristics of 35MWth oxygen-fuel combustion boiler, the thermodynamic calculation program is developed considering actual air leakage. Then, the variable condition calculations of oxygen-fuel combustion boiler are carried out for the six controllable operating parameters affecting boiler operation. The results show that the increase of oxygen concentration at furnace outlet, the decrease of oxygen concentration at furnace inlet, the increase of coal ash, and the increase of moisture will increase the amount of superheated water spray and the boiler exhaust gas heat loss, while the increase of feed water temperature will reduce the amount of coal fired and increase boiler exhaust gas heat loss, and the increase of air leakage rate almost has no influence on boiler exhaust gas heat loss.

articleTitle: A Smart Portable Goniometer-Based Knee Rehabilitation Device Using Arduino Microprocessor and Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: Every year, over 1 million emergency room visits and 1.9 million visits to primary care physicians are due to knee pain; knee pain results in a knee flexion contracture (functional loss of knee extension), decreased strength, and decreased function. Knee-injured patients can recover faster if they receive professional rehabilitation training. However, since professional rehabilitation training is expensive, tedious, and requires high professional knowledge, they are not accessible to many patients. Compared to the general population, athletes have a higher probability to suffer from knee injuries, and the inability to recover quickly or completely can easily affect their careers. By using a low-cost Arduino microprocessor and sensors, a new wearable non-invasive knee rehabilitation device is created, which can provide rehabilitation training tutorials through the accompanying software and prompt the user in real-time whether the posture is correct, thus helping the injured person to perform rehabilitation training in a more standard and safe manner. Compared with the large and expensive devices available on the market, this device has the advantages of being miniature, portable, and low-cost, and aims to provide inexpensive and convenient rehabilitation training guidance for athletes with knee injuries to help them recover quickly and return to the field of play.

articleTitle: Research on Delay Propagation Law of Aviation Equipment Job Shop
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Manufacturing, Industrial Automation and Electronics (ICMIAE)
abstract: The aviation equipment system has a huge structure, complex process flow, multiple coordination and supporting links, and high requirements for complete sets of materials. Affected by random disturbance factors, the delay of a certain component will postpone multiple subsequent assembly processes, resulting in the multiple increase of the final product delivery time. For the job shop in the aviation equipment system, this paper studies the influence of the process delay caused by the random disturbance on the whole system. Using Petri net theory, based on the relationship between processes and the delay propagation unit, in accordance with the spatial sequence of delay propa-gation, the process delay propagation law is analyzed from the three levels within delay propagation unit, between delay propagation unit and in delay propagation network. The proposed method provides the theory for quantifying the effect of delayed propagation in the aviation equipment system, which helps to further refine the control of the production process of the aviation equipment system.
